title: Generic Document
description: Fallback for any document that doesn't match a registered type. Captures whatever key facts are present as loose key-value pairs instead of aborting.

summary.description: one or two sentences describing what this document is

fields.description: every distinct labeled fact on the page, as key/value pairs - dates, names, numbers, headings with a value

key.description: the label as printed, e.g. 'Reference No.'
